name: Metal Masters Inc.
old_description: Since 1973, we’ve been helping customers complete their projects in record time. Whether servicing a business with a piece of broken or worn-down equipment or assisting a homeowner in making necessary modifications to their property, we remain your best bet for satisfactory welding work in North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia.
about:
Metal Masters Inc. was founded in 1973 by Wayne McCullough in Newberry, South Carolina. The company remains under his ownership and operates as a metalwork, welding, mechanical services, and fabrication contractor serving the Southeast.

The shop provides precision machining, CNC and CAD/CAM-based fabrication, welding, process piping, pipe installation, millwright services, maintenance, erection, equipment installation and relocation, and powder coating. It stocks a range of metals from thin gauge to thick plate, tubing, and solid stock, allowing it to begin most orders within 24 to 48 hours.

Metal Masters serves commercial, industrial, and residential customers across North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia. Its clients include businesses needing equipment repair or custom fabrication as well as homeowners requiring property modifications.

The company emphasizes efficiency, accuracy, and budget adherence, leveraging modern CNC and CAD/CAM technology to deliver drawings, quotations, and prototypes quickly. Its team of specialists — including a machine shop foreman, fabrication foreman, field superintendents, and a powder coat supervisor — supports a focus on quality tooling and rapid response.
